title: Trước bình minh
about: Round 26, ke-chuyen ("làm luôn 7 bài cho đủ album"), written to close the album: A minor at 64 bpm, turning to A major. Its motif rises with a turn (A, C-B, E) and falls back a step at a time; in the major the C becomes C#, and the same tune opens as the sky lightens. The arc: the piano alone; the cellos' slow second line; the darkest hour and the climax with the strings and the piano's rolled chords (D6 over G, Esus4 to E7); then A major, the cellos' line and the violas at the sentences' ends; the strings holding the chords softly under the last sentence, ending on C#; the motif once more over D, and the violas' last note into A major. The only major ending of the album. An original tune.
